args.query:
-- Compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel (user.channel from dim_users)
-- Cohort: users who signed up in full ISO weeks; retention measured as share of those users with any activity in days 1..90 after signup

with cohorts as (
  select
    user_id,
    channel,
    signup_date,
    -- cohort_week start (Monday)
    date_trunc('week', signup_date) as cohort_monday
  from dim_users
  where is_internal = false
),
activity as (
  select distinct user_id, completed_date as active_date
  from fct_value_moments
),
cohort_activity as (
  select
    c.user_id,
    c.channel,
    c.cohort_monday,
    c.signup_date,
    min(a.active_date) as first_active_date
  from cohorts c
  left join activity a
    on a.user_id = c.user_id
    and a.active_date between c.signup_date and c.signup_date + 90
  group by 1,2,3,4
),
by_channel as (
  select
    channel,
    count(*) as cohort_size,
    count(case when first_active_date is not null then 1 end) as retained_90
  from cohort_activity
  where signup_date >= date '2026-04-01' and signup_date <= date '2026-07-12'
  group by 1
)
select channel, cohort_size, retained_90, retained_90*1.0/cohort_size as retention_90
from by_channel
order by retention_90 desc;
